title.tagline: A math RPG prototype · learn once, cast many

intro.p1: In the valley village of Numerola, everything runs on numbers: harvests, trade, even magic.
intro.p2: But an ancient Riddle Golem has woken in the eastern ruins and sealed the village spring. The wells are drying up.
intro.p3: You are Kai, a young ninja, and Aino, an apprentice mage. Elder Vesa is waiting for you at the west end of the village.

menu.title: Menu
menu.skillsHelp: Learn a skill from a trainer once, then use it freely. Overcharge it in battle for bonus power.

settings.timersHelp: Ninja overcharges are timed. Relaxed doubles the time, Off removes timers completely.
settings.tutorHelp: Owl the tutor runs on your own computer through Claude Code, Gemini CLI or Codex CLI. Install one of them, run "npm run tutor" in the game folder, and play the game from "npm run dev" on the same computer. Owl only gives hints and questions, never answers.

help.title: How to play
help.move: Move: click where you want to go (the dots show the path), or walk freely with WASD / the arrow keys. Up on the keyboard is up on the screen. Zoom with the mouse wheel or + and −. In battle, WASD pans the camera.
help.talk: Talk / examine: click a person or the rune gate. The party walks over and starts talking. (E also works when you stand next to them.)
help.menu: Menu: Esc · Quests: Q · Skills: K · Bag: I
help.combat1: Battle: each turn a character gains AP (Action Points). Moving costs 1 AP per 3 tiles, and skills show their AP cost.
help.combat2: Click a blue tile to move. Pick a skill with 1–4, then click a target.
help.combat3: ⚡ Overcharge (O): answer a question for a stronger skill. A wrong answer still casts normally.
help.combat4: Space ends the turn. Right-click or Esc cancels a skill.
help.learn1: Learn once, cast many: trainers teach skills through a short trial.
help.learn2: Attunement: skills fade a little after each battle unless you overcharge them. Practise with trainers to restore them.
help.learn3: Stuck? Use the Hint button. Every wrong answer shows the steps.
help.combat5: Height: higher ground gives +25% damage per level and +1 range for ranged skills. Climbing costs extra movement.
help.tutor: AI tutor: when the local tutor is running, untimed questions get an "Ask Owl" button. Owl asks guiding questions and never gives the answer.

classes.kaiDesc: Fast thinking: quick sums, times tables, guess and check.
classes.ainoDesc: Deep thinking: areas, missing numbers, equations.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: Two fast hits of 4 damage each.
flurry.oc: Overcharge: a chain of quick sums against the clock. Every correct answer adds a hit, up to 6 hits.

shadowStep.name: Shadow Step
shadowStep.desc: Teleport to an empty tile up to 5 tiles away.
shadowStep.oc: Overcharge: answer a quick multiplication to become Hidden. Your next attack deals 50% more.

probe.name: Probe Strike
probe.desc: A testing strike: 5 damage. Against a seal, guess x and calculate. If both sides match, the seal shatters.

bolt.name: Staff Bolt
bolt.desc: A spark of magic. 5–7 damage, range 5.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: Burns a 3 × 3 area for 9 damage and leaves fire for 2 rounds. Hits allies too!
fireball.oc: Overcharge: solve an area question for 50% more damage.

mend.name: Mend
mend.desc: Heal an ally (or yourself) for 10 HP.
mend.oc: Overcharge: solve a missing-number puzzle to heal 16 HP instead.

unbind.name: Unbind
unbind.desc: Read a seal as a balance scale and solve for x. A correct answer shatters the seal.

skills.attunement: Attunement {n}% (fades between battles; practise or overcharge to restore)
skills.overchargeDesc: Answer a question while casting. Right: a stronger effect, and the skill stays sharp. Wrong: a normal cast, never a miss.

tonic.name: Herb Tonic
tonic.desc: Restores 15 HP. In battle it costs 1 AP.

tea.name: Focus Tea
tea.desc: In battle: gain 2 AP right away. Costs 0 AP.

seeds.name: Seed Bag
seeds.desc: A bag of 10 seeds. Helmi needs some for her field.

main.title: The Hidden Number
main.desc: The Riddle Golem has sealed Numerola's spring.
main.s2: Learn a seal-breaking skill (Probe Strike or Unbind)
main.s3: Open the rune gate in the east

farm.title: The Crooked Field
farm.desc: Helmi needs seeds for her oddly shaped field.
farm.s2: Work out how many seeds it needs
farm.s3: Buy enough seed bags from Pekka

quests.none: No side quests yet. Maybe someone in the village needs help?

obj.talkElder: Talk to Elder Vesa at the west end of the village.
obj.train: Learn Probe Strike (Master Ren, dojo) or Unbind (Sage Lumi, library).
obj.gate: Go east over the bridge and through the forest to the rune gate.
obj.golem: Enter the ruins and break the Riddle Golem's seals.
obj.farm0: Helmi at the farm (south) might need help.
obj.farm3: Buy seed bags from Pekka ({seeds} seeds needed), then bring them to Helmi.

elder.intro1: Kai, Aino, thank goodness you're here. The Riddle Golem sits on our spring, and no blade can cut its stone shell.
elder.intro2: Its shell is bound by a seal: a hidden number. Find the number and the seal shatters.
elder.intro3: Master Ren at the dojo teaches the ninja way: fast thinking, guess and check. Sage Lumi at the library teaches the mage way: equations that reveal the unknown.
elder.intro4: Learn what you can. Then go east through the forest to the rune gate of the old ruins.
elder.kaiReply: Fast thinking? Sounds like my kind of training.
elder.ainoReply: And mine is the slow, clever kind. We'll find that number, Elder.
elder.intro5: Oh, and Helmi at the farm could use a hand. Even heroes need bread.
elder.golem1: The golem's seals are equations. The first one is simple, but each time you break one, a harder one forms.
elder.golem2: Break its seals, strike while it is open, and the spring is ours again.
elder.hintTrain: You can't break a seal yet. Learn Probe Strike from Master Ren, or Unbind from Sage Lumi. Both is even better.
elder.hintGate: Go east, over the bridge and through the forest. The rune gate guards the ruins.
elder.hintGolem: The gate is open. The golem waits in the ruins. Be brave, and check your answers.
elder.thanks: The spring flows again! Numerola will remember you, Kai and Aino.

ren.busy: Hmph. Speak with Elder Vesa first, then come back.
ren.intro1: So, you want to learn the ninja way. A ninja does not stop to ponder. A ninja knows.
ren.intro2: Each technique starts with a trial. Pass it once and the move is yours. Practise it and it stays sharp.
ren.menuDone: You have learned all I teach. Keep your mind sharp.
ren.about1: Ninja moves cost little and strike fast. Overcharge them and I throw quick questions at you. Answer before the timer runs out!
ren.about2: Probe Strike is guess and check: pick a number, test it on the seal, adjust. Slow? Maybe. But it always works.
ren.sealHint: Remember: against a seal, pick a number for x and calculate. Too small? Go bigger. Too big? Go smaller.

lumi.busy: Ah, visitors! Do talk to Elder Vesa first. He has news.
lumi.intro1: Welcome to the library. A mage's power comes from understanding, not speed.
lumi.intro2: My trials are untimed. Take your time, use hints, and learn to see the shape of a problem.
lumi.menuDone: You've mastered my lessons. The rest is practice.
lumi.about1: Mage spells are strong but cost more AP. Overcharge one and you solve a problem, with no timer, for a bigger effect.
lumi.about2: Unbind reads a seal like a balance scale. Whatever you do to one side, do to the other, until x stands alone.
lumi.sealHint: When you face the golem, cast Unbind and solve its equation. One correct answer breaks the seal.

flurry.intro: Flurry! Strike, strike, strike. To learn it, add and subtract quickly in your head. Four correct answers.
flurry.outro: In battle, turn on Overcharge and every quick correct answer adds one more hit to the combo.

shadowStep.intro: Shadow Step. Times tables, student. A ninja knows them without counting. Four correct.
shadowStep.outro: Overcharge it with a quick multiplication and you vanish into the shadows: your next attack hits 50% harder.

probe.intro: Probe Strike. First, the order of operations: multiply before you add, unless brackets say otherwise.
probe.guess: Now the real lesson. This practice seal says 2x + 1 = 11. Pick a value for x, work out 2x + 1, and see if it makes 11.
probe.keepTrying: Giving up already? A ninja tries again. Pick another number.
probe.outro: Against a seal, Probe Strike lets you test one guess each time. Every miss tells you whether to go bigger or smaller.

fireball.intro: Fireball covers an area: a rectangle of burning ground. Let's learn to measure areas. Rows times columns. Three correct.
fireball.outro: Fireball burns a 3 × 3 area (9 tiles) and leaves flames for 2 rounds. Careful, it burns friends too! Overcharge it with an area question for 50% more damage.

mend.intro: Mend heals by filling in what is missing. So: missing-number puzzles. What goes in the box? Four correct.
mend.outro: Overcharge Mend with a missing-number puzzle and it heals 16 instead of 10.

unbind.intro: Unbind is the deepest lesson: the balance scale. A bag hides an unknown number of weights. Keep the scale level and find out how many.
unbind.stage1: One bag and 3 weights balance 7 weights. Take weights off, but always the same on both sides!
unbind.stage2: Two bags and 1 weight balance 9 weights. When only bags are left on one side, split both sides into equal groups.
unbind.stage3: Bags on both sides! You can take a bag off each side too, because a bag weighs the same everywhere.
unbind.symbols: Wonderful. Now the same thing without the scale, just symbols. x is the bag, and the numbers are weights.
unbind.outro: With Unbind, one correct answer shatters a seal. Picture the scale and it will help you think.

pekka.busy: Shop's not open yet, friend. The Elder was looking for you!
pekka.hello: Welcome to Pekka's! Tonics, tea, seeds, all honestly priced. Mostly.
pekka.chat1: Business? Everyone counts their coins twice since the spring dried up.
pekka.chat2: Tip: if you can work out a discount in your head, I might just throw in something for free.

shop.title: Pekka's Shop
shop.greeting: Prices are per piece. Type how many you want.
shop.badQty: Type a whole number, 1 or more.
shop.noGold: That costs {cost} gold, but you only have {gold}.
shop.haggleStory: Pekka grins: "Work this out and I'll throw in a Herb Tonic."
shop.haggleWin: "Sharp! Here, a Herb Tonic on the house."
shop.haggleLose: "Ha! Better luck next time, friend." (Pekka only haggles once.)

helmi.busy: Oh, hello! Have you seen the Elder? He's been asking for you.
helmi.intro1: Kai! Aino! Perfect timing. I need to sow my new field, but it's a crooked thing.
helmi.intro2: It's like a rectangle with a corner bitten off. I need 3 seeds for every square metre.
helmi.intro3: If I buy too few, part of it stays bare. Too many and I waste coins. Can you work out how much it needs?
helmi.ask: Will you help me plan the field?
helmi.later: No worries. The field isn't going anywhere.
helmi.comeBack: Come back whenever you're ready to finish the plan.
helmi.planned: {area} m², so {seeds} seeds! Pekka sells them in bags of {bag}. Could you buy what we need and bring it here?
helmi.needSeeds: We need {seeds} seeds. Pekka sells them in bags of {bag}.
helmi.short: You have {have} seeds, but the field needs {need}. That's {missing} short.
helmi.under: We planted what we could, about {pct}% of the field. It'll do, but a few rows stay bare.
helmi.over: All planted! Though... that's {extra} seeds too many, {bags} bag(s) you didn't need. Thanks anyway!
helmi.exact: Perfect! {bags} bags and only {left} seeds left over. You can't buy part of a bag, so that's spot on. Take these tonics too!
helmi.done: The field is growing. Thank you for your help!
helmi.doneExact: Look at those sprouts, every square metre covered. You're a natural farmer!

farm.title: Planning Helmi's field
farm.intro: Each square is 1 m². Helmi needs {rate} seeds per m². Choose any way to work out the area. They all give the same answer!
farm.qArea: What is the area of the field in m²?
farm.qSeeds: The field is {area} m². With {rate} seeds per m², how many seeds are needed?
farm.forgotCorner: That's the whole 8 × 6 rectangle, but a corner is missing!

hint.none: Try one of the ways to think above.
hint.count: Count every square inside the field. The numbers help.
hint.split: Find the areas of A and B separately, then add them.
hint.subtract: The big 8 × 6 rectangle, minus the missing 3 × 2 corner.

gate.locked: Runes glow on a sealed stone gate. A voice rumbles: "Only those who can find a hidden number may pass." (Learn Probe Strike or Unbind first.)
gate.intro: The runes on the gate glow, one number on each stone. There's a pattern...
gate.opened: The last rune flares and the gate grinds open. Cold air flows out of the ruins.
gate.foreshadow: Kai, did you see? The rule was 3 × n + 4, and 25 was on rune 7. I bet the golem's seals work the same way.

runes.title: The Rune Gate
runes.s1: Five rune stones. The last one has no number.
runes.h1: How much bigger is each rune than the one before?
runes.e1: Each rune is {d} more than the one before: {last} + {d} = {ans}.
runes.s2: Far down the wall, another rune lights up: rune #10.
runes.h2: Rune #1 is {m} × 1 + {a}. Rune #2 is {m} × 2 + {a}. See the rule?
runes.e2: The rule is {m} × position + {a}. So rune #10 is {m} × 10 + {a} = {ans}.
runes.s3: Now the gate asks the opposite question.
runes.h3: {m} × n + {a} = {v}. Undo the steps: take away {a}, then divide by {m}.

battle.forest1: Slimes! Watch out, Aino. They're made of loose numbers.
battle.golem2: NO BLADE CAN CUT ME. NO FIRE CAN BURN ME. ONLY THE HIDDEN NUMBER.
battle.golemAino: Look at the seal around it. It's an equation! Find x and it breaks.
battle.sealRule: While the golem is sealed, it takes no damage. Break the seal to make it vulnerable, and it also loses its next turn. When its health drops far enough, a new, harder seal forms.
battle.tipProbe: Kai, Probe Strike: guess a value for x and calculate. Too small or too big? Adjust and try again.
battle.tipUnbind: Aino, Unbind: solve the equation like a balance scale. One correct answer breaks the seal.

tutorial.title: Battle basics
tutorial.l1: Battles are turn-based on a grid. Each turn a character gains 4 Action Points (AP), and can save up to 6.
tutorial.l2: Click a blue tile to move (1 AP buys 3 tiles). Click an enemy next to you to attack. WASD pans the camera and the mouse wheel zooms.
tutorial.l3: Use number keys 1–4 or the buttons for skills. Each shows its AP cost. Some need a few turns to cool down.
tutorial.l4: Skills you've learned work without any math. Turn on ⚡ Overcharge (O) to answer a question for a stronger effect.
tutorial.l5: Press Space or End turn when you're done. Right-click or Esc cancels a skill.
tutorial.l6: Height matters. Attacks from higher ground deal more damage, and ranged skills reach 1 tile further. Climbing up costs extra movement, and you can only climb one level at a time.

combat.staggered: {name} is staggered and loses its turn!
combat.sealAbsorbs: The seal absorbs the blow on {name}.
combat.sealHolds: The seal holds. Check the steps and try again next turn.
combat.hintMove: Click to move · click an enemy to attack
combat.loseText: Your party falls, but heroes get back up. Try the battle again with full health.
combat.winForest: The slimes dissolve into scattered digits. The forest path is clear.
combat.attuneNote: Tip: skills you didn't overcharge lose a little attunement after each battle. Practise with your trainers to make them sharp again.
combat.winGolem: The last seal cracks and the golem crumbles into sand. Water bursts from the spring!

probe.intro: The seal reads: {eq}. Pick a whole number for x to test.
probe.wholeNumber: Pick a whole number from 0 to 99.
probe.left: Test x = {n} in the left side of {eq}.
probe.right: Now the right side of {eq}, with x = {n}.
probe.logSlip: x = {n}: the calculation slipped and the strike went wide.
probe.logMiss: x = {n}: the left side, {lhs}, is {rel} the right side, {rhs}.

unbind.hint: Take the plain weights off both sides first, then split into equal groups.
unbind.hintBags: First take the same number of bags off both sides.
unbind.story: The seal appears as a balance scale. Find x to unbind it.

balance.howto: Click a bag or a weight to take it off. Keep the scale level!
balance.tipped: Tipped! Do the same on the other side to level it.
balance.level: Level. Keep going until one bag stands alone.
balance.countAgain: Count the weights on the other side.

q.area: A rectangle is {w} m wide and {h} m tall. What is its area in m²?
q.percent: The price is {p} gold. With {pct}% off, how much do you pay?

hint.add: Start from {a} and count up {b} more.
hint.sub: Count up from {b} to {a}. How many steps?
hint.area: Each row has {w} squares, and there are {h} rows.
hint.missingAdd: What do you add to {a} to get {c}? Or work out {c} − {a}.
hint.missingSub: Take away something from {c} to get {a}. Try {c} − {a}.
hint.opsMulFirst: Multiply first, then add or subtract.
hint.eq2: First take {b} away from both sides, then divide by {a}.
hint.percent: {pct}% of {p} is {p} × {pct} ÷ 100. Then take that away from {p}.

explain.sealSplit: Split both sides into {a} equal groups: {eq}

ending.title: The spring flows again!
ending.p1: The Riddle Golem crumbles, and clear water rushes down to Numerola.
ending.p2: Kai learned that guess and check always works, and Aino learned that algebra is the shortcut.

tutor.title: Owl the tutor
tutor.greeting: Hoo! I won't tell you the answer, but I'll help you find it. What feels tricky?
tutor.stuckMsg: I'm still stuck. Can you help a bit more?
tutor.redacted: (Owl nearly gave the answer away, so that part is hidden.)
tutor.visualGrid: There is a picture of a grid of squares, {w} wide and {h} tall.
tutor.visualBalance: There is a picture of a balance scale showing {eq}, where x is a bag and numbers are weights.
tutor.balanceTask: Balance-scale puzzle: take the same things off both sides until one bag stands alone, then say how many weights are in a bag.
tutor.farmContext: Helmi's field is an 8 m × 6 m rectangle with a 3 m × 2 m corner missing. She needs 3 seeds per square metre.
tutor.probeTask: Guess and check: the player picks a whole number for x, calculates both sides, and sees whether they match.
